description_expanded: SummaryDiscover Southern Tides, a luxurious 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home in the highly sought-after Magnolia Cottages by the Sea. This spacious vacation rental features a 6-seater golf cart, deeded beach access, and a resort-style pool just steps away. Accommodating up to 14 guests, it boasts a fully equipped kitchen, relaxing screened-in porch, and stylish coastal decor.SpaceWelcome to Southern Tides in Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, where coastal charm meets modern luxury in this stunning 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom property! Nestled in a serene well-positioned community located between Alys & Rosemary Beach to the east and Watersound and Seaside to the west, this home is designed for both comfort and style, providing an unforgettable getaway experience. As you enter the property, you are greeted by an open concept living space adorned with comfortable neutral decor, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The fully equipped kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, a professional ice maker, solid surface countertops, and ample cabinet space, making it a haven for culinary enthusiasts. The four well-appointed bedrooms offer a retreat for every guest, each with its own en-suite bathroom for added convenience and privacy. Rest your head on your favorite pillow chosen from our personalized pillow menu! The master suite is located on the first floor and features a luxurious king-sized bed, walk-in closet, a bright beautiful bathroom with designer finishes and a walk-in shower. For larger groups or families, the bunk nook provides a whimsical and comfortable space for up to 14 people, perfect for children or additional guests. This cozy corner adds a touch of versatility to the property, accommodating a range of sleeping arrangements. Children and adults will love the included arcade and books ready for story time. One of the standout features of this property is the included golf cart, providing effortless transportation to the deeded beach access. Explore the pristine shores and enjoy the sun, sand, and surf with ease. Whether you're heading to the beach for a day of relaxation or an evening drive, the golf cart ensures a convenient and enjoyable experience for all. The spacious screened in porch offers the perfect spot for coffee or cocktails, or simply unwinding with a good book after a fun day at the beach. This home is also steps away from the resort-style, zero entry pool and green space, perfect for lawn games and activities. Enjoy the included beach toys, chairs, and games. Immerse yourself in the coastal lifestyle as you bask in the beauty of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea! With its well-appointed bedrooms, stylish decor, and thoughtful amenities, this property invites you to experience the best of beachside living in a setting that combines luxury with the laid-back charm of coastal living! Traveling with a larger group? SOUTHERN TIDES can be rented along iwth GOIN' COASTAL. Goin' Coastal is just a few steps away and comes with it's own golf cart as well! Goin' Coastal sleeps 7 and is pet friendly (Southern Tides is for humans only). TRANSPORTATION - Street Legal 6 person golf cart (with signed waiver - must be 25 to operate) - Bikes are popular on 30A! Should you decide to rent some, a discount code to a local bike shop will be provided with your arrival information HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Golf Cart Parking: There's designated parking at the front of the neighborhood between Morgan Street and the Waterhouse condos. - Large resort style pool (heated depending on ambient nightly temperatures) - Community green space (located at pool) BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided upon request SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 14) - Primary Suite - 1st floor: King bed, private bathroom with walk in shower - Queen Bedroom 2nd floor: Queen bed, private bathroom with walk in shower - Full Bedroom x 2: 2nd floor: 2 full beds, private bathroom with tub/shower - Bunk Room 2nd floor: TwinXL/Queen bunks (2 sets) private bath with tub/shower - Bunk Nook - 1st floor (2 twins) FEATURES: - 30A – 4 Bedroom / 4.5 Bathroom House - Sleeps 14 (1 King, 1 Queen, 2 Fulls, 2 Twins (hallway bunks), 2 Twin XL over 2 Queen bunks) - 6-Seater STREET LEGAL Golf Cart - Gas Grill - Relaxing Screened-In Porch - Large Sun-filled Open Floor Plan - Fully Appointed Kitchen with professional ice maker - Full Size Washer & Dryer - TVs in living room and all bedrooms - FREE WiFi - upgraded high speed internet - Use of 4 Beach Chairs, Umbrellas & Wagon - Parking for 2 cars in driveway and 1 on street - Large Resort Style Community Pool - Close Proximity To The Beach -– neighborhood deeded beach access is immediately across 30A - 18 Mile Bike Path Along 30A - Close to The Big Chill (1.5 miles), Seaside, Seagrove, Rosemary Beach (2 miles) and Alys Beach (1 mile). Rosemary Beach and Seaside have Farmers Markets throughout the year along with great restaurants and shops.NotesA Note on Shared Amenities: Please keep in mind that these spaces are operated by the HOA. Because of this, they are subject to seasonal availability—common seasonal closures may include April-May and Sept-Nov—and we can't be held responsible for unexpected closures or repairs. If you are booking specifically for a shared amenity, please feel free to reach out with any questions in advance!House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 19. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 20. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. 21. Bicycles must yield to pedestrians when riding on sidewalks. Use designated crosswalks and follow all traffic laws. 22. Helmets are required for riders under 16. Nighttime riding requires a front light and rear reflectors for visibility. 23. Only licensed and insured drivers may operate golf carts and low-speed vehicles (LSVs). 24. Golf carts and LSVs must follow Florida motor vehicle laws and may only be driven on roads with speed limits of 35 mph or less. 25. Golf carts and LSVs may not be driven on sidewalks or bike paths. Working headlights and taillights are required for nighttime use. 26. Bicycles must be locked when parked and marked with identification for return. Guests are responsible for any loss, theft, or damage during the rental. 27. Golf cart and LSV drivers must ensure all passengers wear seatbelts and do not exceed passenger limits. 28. Reckless driving or unauthorized modifications to golf carts and LSVs is prohibited. Park responsibly and return vehicles clean and fully charged or refueled. 29. LSVs and bicycles are not allowed within the Rosemary Beach Community. 30. Guests are responsible for any fines, tickets, or damages incurred during use. Bicycles and golf carts/LSVs must be returned in the same condition as provided. 31. Guests acknowledge the inherent risks of using bicycles and operating golf carts/LSVs. 32. Guests agree to indemnify and hold harmless LocalVR, its owners, and employees from any claims or damages arising from use. 33. LocalVR and the property owner are not liable for injuries or damages incurred, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct.Read Less
